name: Aloo Sev
ingredients_raw: EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (CONTAINS ONE OR MORE OF THE FOLLOWINGS: PALMOLEN RACE BRAN, CORN, COTTONSEED), CHICKPEA FLOUR, POTATO FLAKES (21%), SEASONING MALTODEXTRIN, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, SPICES & CONDIMENTS (ORY MANGO, CUMIN FENNEL CHILL, CORIANDER, CLOVE, TURMERIC, PEPPER CARDAMOM, GINGER), DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE POWDER (MINT 0.2%, GARLIC, TAMARIND), FLAVOUR NATURAL NATURE DENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS-330 INS 2 FLAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 635), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551, INS 341 (11))]. RICE FLOUR AS FLAVOURING & SEASONING AGENT
